title: 🧑‍💼 Welcome to TKU Theme Park
description: Annyeong! This park is a place to relax, play, and enjoy. Take your time exploring, try our mini games, and have fun at your own pace. Stay as long as you want and create some happy memories along the way.
footer:
Have fun exploring the park and enjoy your visit! 💚💜 
We would love to hear your feedback and suggestions for improvement.
